prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign and choose_path layout) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 tests (rounds 1 and 7).
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 4 tests.
Adoption layout (3 tests) and choose_path redesign (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes showed no clear effect or hurt performance across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, choose_path copy, finish layout, finish copy, finish redesign, home notification, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption new_screen (fewer than 2 agreeing tests).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet selection step with a compact grid layout featuring choice card components for quicker character selection. (why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in the onboarding funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89 seconds.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Pet Fast Adoption Flow: Add an instant pet avatar selection flow within photo upload to allow users to skip photo rendering issues. (why: Custom pet rendering fails or creates wrong results for multiple users (3 support tickets), causing adoption drop-off.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Shortcut & Docking Setup Screen: Add a new setup screen before completion explaining desktop placement, pet hiding, and screen docking shortcuts. (why: Multiple support emails (3 tickets) report confusion about controlling, hiding, or finding the pet on the desktop.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery Security Headline Copy Update: Update the sign-in screen headline and hint text to emphasize automatic pet data protection and cloud saving. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Name Entry Hint Safeguard: Display a helpful hint and companion mascot badge explaining that pet names can be changed anytime later. (why: Adoption takes median 89s with 60.9% drop-off as users overthink official companion details.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Sound & Alert: Add an optional readiness chime and notification badge on the waiting screen when desktop pet rendering completes. (why: Home wait step has high mean duration (2336s) and users complain about pet not appearing on desktop.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Animation Companion Display: Add an animated mascot preview and step counter to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s; visual feedback reduces perceived waiting time.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Story Welcome Layout: Change the welcome story screen to a split layout with pet illustration side-by-side with welcome text. (why: Choose path step has 81% conversion; improving entry appeal sets clearer expectations upfront.)
8: [finish, incentive] First Day Desktop Pet Reward Checklist: Add a starter reward checklist component on the home intro screen incentivizing initial pet interactions. (why: Finish completion drops to 68% and users express confusion about post-setup pet controls.)
